title: The Raped Little Runaway
author: Jean Martin
current_text: The Censorship of Publications Board banned The Raped Little Runaway in March 2016; the board found it “indecent” and “obscene” because it contained multiple descriptions of child rape. A 42-year-old man was convicted at Ennis Circuit Criminal Court of possessing The Raped Little Runaway in 2014, before it was banned; he was convicted under child pornography legislation rather than for possessing a banned book and was fined €500.

sources.quote: Last year, The Raped Little Runaway by Jean Martin and published by Star Distributors Ltd became the first book to be banned by the Irish Censorship of Publications Board since 1998.
